judge_reasoning: The model's solution activates Liliana, Death's Majesty's loyalty ability three times in a single turn (+1, +1, then -7), which violates the fundamental Magic rule that a planeswalker's loyalty ability can only be activated once per turn (CR 606.3). This makes the entire proposed line illegal as written. Additionally, the model incorrectly assumes Trial of Solidarity's one-time +2/+1 buff (locked in at resolution) would apply to Zombie tokens created later via Liliana's +1 or Doomed Dissenter's death trigger, leading to an incorrect damage calculation. Because the core sequence relies on an illegal repeated activation of the same planeswalker's loyalty ability, the solution fails to be rules-legal, regardless of whether the final life total math might otherwise work out.
model_solution:
1. Cast Trial of Solidarity
2. Cast Doomed Dissenter
3. Activate Liliana, Death's Majesty's +1 ability (create 2/2 Zombie, mill 2)
4. Activate Liliana's +1 ability again (create 2/2 Zombie, mill 2)
5. Activate Liliana's -7 ability (destroy all non-Zombie creatures)
   - This causes Wayward Disciple to trigger four times as my creatures die, making opponent lose 4 life (10 → 6)
   - Doomed Dissenter's death creates a third 2/2 Zombie token
6. Declare all three 2/2 Zombies (each 4/3 from Trial of Solidarity) attacking
7. All attacks are unblocked (opponent has no creatures), dealing 12 damage total
8. Opponent dies (6 - 12 = -6 life)
